decision.rationale: TXN-007963 is a charge of 3445.02 EUR to BRIGHTWATER DEVICES (MER-000050) on card CRD-000236. It posted on 2026-09-12. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 48 days later, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008166, shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and no PIN, and the fraud flag is set. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, that makes it an unauthorised payment, and the full 344502 cents would be credited. Under provisional-credit, the automated process never grants a provisional credit above 3,000.00 EUR. Because this credit would be larger, a specialist must decide, and no action is proposed. No documents were attached, and the records contain no instructions.
